articles.title: FRRO Mumbai issues show-cause notice to Imran to cancel OCI tag over presence at stir site
articles.summary: FRRO Mumbai issues second notice to US actor Imran Khan, seeking reply on why his OCI status should not be cancelled over protest participation.
articles.body: MUMBAI: After issuing actor Imran Khan a leave India notice on Oct 14, Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO), Mumbai, on Saturday sent him a second notice, this time asking him to show-cause why his Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) status should not be cancelled.Khan, a US national, was granted OCI cardholder status on Dec 15, 2006. To decide if OCI registration should be cancelled, Centre views as relevant the “nature and circumstances” of activities undertaken in India and their implications.The notice cites his presence at the August Kranti Maidan protest in support of CJP’s anti-CEC stir in Delhi. The notice says no police permission was granted for the protest and a case was registered against him and other protesters for unlawful assembly.Also read: 'Made scapegoat, was curious about crowd': What actor Imran Khan's plea saysFRRO has sought his reply in 15 days as the law provides for a hearing before any action is taken to revoke an OCI card under the provisions of the Citizenship Act, 1955.FRRO acknowledges, though, that the FIR registration and detention by themselves are not conclusive proof of the allegations or an automatic ground for cancellation of his OCI registration, nor does participation, by itself, establish a ground for cancellation.However, FRRO said, the nature, circumstances and implications of acts on the interest of the public, and the OCI’s conduct, are to be examined, where relevant, to see if registration should be cancelled under section 7D of the Citizenship Act.The Citizenship Act Section 7D (e) empowers revocation of OCI in the interests of the sovereignty, integrity of India and security of India, friendly relations with any foreign country, or in the interests of the general public. Centre said it was of the “provisional opinion” that Khan’s registration as an OCI Cardholder may be liable to cancellation under this section, subject to his reply and explanations.FRRO cited an SC ruling to say national security falls under a “broad range of public interests” when legal powers are directed towards the protection of the interests of the state and the public, based always on facts as well.Khan’s advocate Zulfiquar Memon of MZM Legal said, “As his legal representatives, we are currently examining the contents of the new show-cause notice issued to Imran and we look forward to complying and cooperating with the FRRO in terms of replying to the notice. However, we will take this point up before the high court when the matter comes up for hearing so that we get clarity on the status of the earlier issued leave India notice in light of this new show-cause notice issued by the FRRO.”Centre said his participation, detention and related circumstances warrant scrutiny on whether his continued OCI status is consistent with the interests of the general public, and has factored in the distinction between Indians and OCIs and the limited and regulated rights available to OCIs.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Mumbai | Silver Rate in Mumbai | Bank Holidays in Mumbai | Public Holidays in Mumbai | Mumbai AQI | Weather in Mumbai | Petrol Price in Mumbai | Diesel Price in Mumbai | CNG Price in Mumbai | LPG Price in MumbaiStay updated with the latest Mumbai news. articles.title: Bombom de chocolate com cebola: doce exótico de atrai turistas em SC | G1
articles.standfirst: Doce foi criado por engenheira de alimentos em Ituporanga, cidade conhecida como Capital Nacional da Cebola. Unidade custa R$ 4 e desperta curiosidade de moradores e turistas.
articles.summary: O bombom de cebola criado em Ituporanga custa R$ 4 e atrai turistas curiosos com uma receita agridoce que homenageia a Capital Nacional da Cebola.
articles.body:
🍫 Um bombom de chocolate com recheio de cebola é alvo de curiosidade e virou até atração turística em Ituporanga , no Vale do Itajaí, em Santa Catarina .

A iguaria foi criada pela engenheira de alimentos Adriana Corrêa Bittencourt, dona de uma marca de chocolates artesanais no município, conhecido como a Capital Nacional da Cebola.

Ela contou ao g1 que a mistura surgiu para homenagear os colonizadores locais durante o primeiro Festival Gastronômico do município. Três anos depois, segue sendo vendida por R$ 4 a unidade.

“Em um primeiro momento, pensei em desistir diante de algumas caras feias sobre o que poderia dar disso. Mas depois das aulas e direcionamentos do Sebrae, o chef me disse: 'por que não'?. Foi aí que fui para a cozinha testar”, disse.

🧅De acordo com o Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE), Ituporanga produziu 168 mil toneladas de cebola em uma área de 4,8 mil hectares em 2025, e ficou na segunda posição entre os maiores produtores do país.

Bombom de cebola foi criado por empresária em Ituporanga — Foto: Arquivo pessoal

A receita leva cebola roxa caramelizada, processo utilizado para reduzir a acidez do vegetal.

Depois, o ingrediente é misturado a uma ganache de chocolate 40% cacau (cuja receita a empresária mantém em segredo 🤐).

A preparação é finalizada com a trufagem do bombom.

A reação de quem experimenta o doce é uma das partes mais divertidas da experiência, segundo Adriana. Enquanto alguns demonstram receio, outros ficam curiosos para descobrir o sabor da combinação.

Entre os comentários mais inusitados, a empresária já ouviu comparações com hambúrguer e relatos de pessoas que aprovaram o doce, mas disseram que não o comeriam novamente.

Também há quem afirme não gostar da receita. Entre as crianças, algumas chegam a confundir o recheio com manga. O sabor final, no entanto, é agridoce.

"A receita combinou justamente com o chocolate 40%. Ela não combinou com o chocolate ao leite, combinou com uma versão de chocolate meio amargo", conta.

Com o passar dos anos, a curiosidade do público passou a influenciar a criação de novos sabores.

De acordo com Adriana, após três anos do lançamento, os pedidos por experiências diferentes se tornaram mais frequentes, incluindo versões com mais cebola ou com toque picante. Há inclusive turistas que chegam à loja convictos do pedido: bombom de cebola.

De acordo com Adriana, três anos após o lançamento, os pedidos por experiências diferentes se tornaram mais frequentes. Há até turistas que chegam à loja já certos do que querem: experimentar o bombom de cebola que viram nas redes sociais.

Há também turistas que chegam à loja decididos a experimentar o doce que viram nas redes sociais. “Hoje, dentro da loja, a procura às vezes é só pelo bombom. As pessoas entram e falam: ‘Eu vim para comprar o bombom de cebola’. E acabam levando apenas ele”, diz.

articles.title: ‘This film will be a big hit’: Vijay Deverakonda says his and Rashmika Mandanna starrer ‘Ranabaali’ will be one of the best Telugu films of 2026 despite mixed reviews and a drop in box-office collections
articles.summary: Vijay Deverakonda has expressed confidence in his period drama ‘Ranabaali’ despite its mixed response from audiences and critics.
articles.body: Vijay Deverakonda has expressed confidence in his period drama ‘Ranabaali’ despite its mixed response from audiences and critics. The actor believes the Rashmika Mandanna-starrer will be remembered as one of the best Telugu films of 2026, insisting that the project was made to tell an important story rather than simply achieve big box-office numbers. He also praised director Rahul Sankrityan’s storytelling and said the film has several layers for audiences to discover.Vijay Deverakonda says ‘Ranabaali’ will be one of the best Telugu films of 2026Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s period drama ‘Ranabaali’ has received a mixed response from audiences and critics. Amid the varied reviews, Vijay has spoken about his expectations from the film, saying he believes it will be remembered as “one of the best Telugu films of 2026”.According to The Indian Express, the actor made the remarks at a press meet on Friday after watching the film the previous night. He said the project holds a special place in his career and could leave a lasting impact on Telugu cinema.“When I watched the film yesterday, I felt that it would be one of the best Telugu films of the year. I had said during the pre-release event that this film would make Telugu cinema proud,” he said.The actor also reflected on how certain films continue to define an artist’s career, even after they have worked on several projects. Referring to ‘Ranabaali’ as his 14th film, he said some performances and stories remain with audiences long after their release.“For all of us, when we look back at our filmographies — this is my 14th film — even after making 25 or 30 films, there will be certain films that people will talk about forever. The impact of those films and the performances in them will remain in people’s hearts,” he added.Vijay Deverakonda says ‘Ranabaali’ was made for a bigger purposeDespite the film’s box-office performance, Vijay maintained that the team had a larger purpose in bringing ‘Ranabaali’ to the screen. According to the actor, the project was not conceived simply to secure a hit or deliver high collections.“And this film, too, will be a big hit. I can see how it is doing, how you are receiving it, how deeply it has impacted you and how passionately you are talking about it. I have been reading your messages and reviews, sharing some of them and enjoying your reactions. You have taken this film forward,” he said.Vijay also praised director Rahul Sankrityan for the way he presented the story and developed its different layers. He said the team considered the subject important enough to tell, regardless of the commercial expectations surrounding the release.“But when we made it, we had something else in mind. We did not make this film merely to deliver a hit or achieve huge box office numbers. Its purpose was much bigger. We felt this was a very important story to tell our people. The way Rahul has presented it is remarkable. When you watch the film, you will discover so many layers to its world,” he said.‘Ranabaali’ box office collection: Film sees a drop on day 2According to Sacnilk, ‘Ranabaali’ collected Rs 7.30 crore in India net collections on Saturday, October 17. This represented a 21.1% decline from its reported opening-day collection of Rs 9.25 crore. The film’s worldwide gross collection reportedly reached Rs 26.65 crore after two days in theatres.While the second-day figures indicated a drop in domestic collections, Vijay’s comments suggest that he remains confident about the film’s long-term impact and the story it sets out to tell.‘Ranabaali’ cast and director‘Ranabaali’ stars Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna in the lead roles and is directed by Rahul Sankrityan. Hollywood actor Arnold Vosloo, known for his role in ‘The Mummy’, also features in the film as the antagonist, Sir Theodore Hector.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Jailer 2’ box office collection Day 4 [LIVE]: Rajinikanth starrer sets sight on Rs 200 crore gross on first Sunday after surpassing Vijay’s ‘Jana Nayagan’ and Suriya’s ‘Karuppu’
articles.summary: Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ is continuing its theatrical run with strong reported collections in its opening four days.
articles.body: Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ is continuing its theatrical run with strong reported collections in its opening four days. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the action entertainer has crossed Rs 155 crore in India net collections, according to the live figures provided in the latest update. The film’s Tamil version is leading its domestic performance, while comparisons with Vijay’s ‘Jana Nayagan’ and Suriya’s ‘Karuppu’ have drawn attention to its box-office run.Jailer 2 Review'Jailer 2' opening day, Day 2 and Day 3 collections ‘Jailer 2’ collected Rs 37.10 crore India net on Day 2 (Friday, October 16), following its strong opening. The Rajinikanth-starrer earned Rs 47.25 crore India net on Day 3 (Saturday, October 17), taking its cumulative three-day total to Rs 144.05 crore.‘Jailer 2’ Day 4 live box office collection trackingRajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ has reportedly collected Rs 21.60 crore in India net collections on Day 4, Sunday, October 18, across 7,273 shows so far, according to the figures provided in the live update.The Tamil version leads the day’s collections with Rs 16.02 crore from 3,838 shows. The Telugu version has contributed Rs 3.51 crore across 1,078 shows, while the Hindi version has earned Rs 2.07 crore from 2,357 shows.With these provisional figures, the film’s cumulative India net collection stands at Rs 165.65 crore, while its India gross collection has reached Rs 194.49 crore. The final collection for Sunday is yet to be reported, and the numbers may change as further data comes in.Day-wise box office collection of ‘Jailer 2’Day 1: Rs 59.70 croreDay 2: Rs 37.10 croreDay 3: Rs 47.25 croreDay 4 [LIVE]: Rs 21.60 croreTOTAL: Rs 165.65 crore‘Jailer 2’ moves ahead of ‘Jana Nayagan’ and ‘Karuppu’With its reported India net collection at Rs 165.65 crore, ‘Jailer 2’ has moved past the four-day India net totals cited for Vijay’s ‘Jana Nayagan’ and Suriya’s ‘Karuppu’. According to Sacnilk figures, ‘Jana Nayagan’ had collected Rs 124.75 crore in India net by Day 4, including Rs 32 crore on its fourth day. ‘Karuppu’, meanwhile, recorded an India net collection of Rs 82.30 crore and an India gross of Rs 95.30 crore through Day 4.On the basis of these reported figures, Rajinikanth’s sequel is ahead of both films in the domestic collection comparison. The comparison is based on the stated four-day totals and should be read in the context of provisional box-office estimates, which can vary across trackers and updates.‘Jailer 2’ heads towards the end of its opening weekendDirected by Nelson Dilipkumar, ‘Jailer 2’ follows the 2023 film ‘Jailer’, which featured Rajinikanth in the lead role. The sequel brings the superstar back in an action entertainer, with Anirudh Ravichander composing the music. The film features a prominent ensemble cast that includes Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar, Ramya Krishnan, Mithun Chakraborty and S. J. Suryah.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources. articles.title: Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran to marry in Greece on November 11, Kalanithi Maran plans exclusive gifts for celebrity guests and a grand Chennai reception - Report
articles.summary: Wedding rumours surrounding music composer Anirudh Ravichander and Sunrisers Hyderabad co-owner Kavya Maran have generated considerable interest, with
articles.body: Wedding rumours surrounding music composer Anirudh Ravichander and Sunrisers Hyderabad co-owner Kavya Maran have generated considerable interest, with reports suggesting that the couple could marry in Greece on November 11, followed by a reception in Chennai on November 21. According to a report by Filmibeat, Kavya’s father, Sun Group chairman Kalanithi Maran, is reportedly planning exclusive return gifts for prominent guests, alongside elaborate hospitality arrangements. However, the couple and their families have not officially confirmed the reported wedding dates or details.Kalanithi Maran reportedly plans exclusive gifts for Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran’s wedding guestsAccording to Filmibeat, Kalanithi Maran is making arrangements for the reported wedding celebrations of his daughter, Kavya Maran, and music composer Anirudh Ravichander. The report suggests that the family is considering exclusive return gifts for prominent guests expected to attend the celebrations. The proposed gifts are reportedly intended for personalities from the film industry, business circles and politics. However, the nature of the presents has not been disclosed, and the reported arrangements remain unconfirmed by the families.Given the families’ connections across entertainment and business, the reported guest list has also attracted attention. Neither Anirudh nor Kavya has publicly confirmed the wedding details mentioned in the report.Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran’s reported Greece wedding and Chennai receptionAccording to the report, Anirudh and Kavya are expected to get married in Greece on November 11, followed by a reception in Chennai on November 21. The reported celebrations are expected to bring together guests from the worlds of cinema, business and politics. The Greece ceremony and Chennai reception would mark two key occasions for the families to celebrate with their invitees.However, the dates and venues have not been officially announced by the couple or their families. The reported schedule should therefore be treated as unconfirmed.Grand hospitality reportedly planned for Anirudh and Kavya’s receptionApart from the proposed return gifts, an elaborate feast is reportedly being planned for the Chennai reception. According to the report, the arrangements are intended to offer guests a memorable experience, with attention to hospitality and the overall celebration. While details of the menu, guest list and other arrangements have not been made public, reports about the proposed gifts and reception have added to the interest surrounding the rumoured wedding.Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran’s reported wedding plans remain unconfirmedAnirudh Ravichander is one of the prominent music composers working in Indian cinema, while Kavya Maran is associated with the Sun Group and is a co-owner of Sunrisers Hyderabad. Their reported wedding plans have drawn attention because of their respective profiles in entertainment and business.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Drishyam 3 The Conclusion' box office collection Day 17 [LIVE]: Ajay Devgn thriller aims for Rs 350 crore domestic net on third Sunday
articles.summary: Ajay Devgn’s crime thriller Drishyam 3: The Conclusion continues its triumphant theatrical run on Day 17.
articles.body: Ajay Devgn’s crime thriller Drishyam 3: The Conclusion continues its triumphant theatrical run on Day 17. Directed by Abhishek Pathak, the suspense drama has crossed Rs 343 crore net in India and pushed its worldwide earnings past Rs 528 crore. With steady weekend footfalls, the blockbuster franchise finale is now aiming for higher domestic and global box office benchmarks.Having comfortably passed the Rs. 500 crore worldwide mark, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' is now setting its sights on key theatrical targets. It is cruising toward the Rs 350 crore net mark in India, which it is expected to cross during the upcoming weekdays. With respect to the global benchmark, the film is aiming to touch the Rs. 550 crore worldwide gross milestone before ending its theatrical run.'Drishyam 3 The Conclusion' domestic box office runThe film earned Rs. 245.50 crore net in week 1 and another Rs. 87.50 crore in week 2, which took the India net to Rs. 333 crore at the end of Day 14. Day 15, the third Friday, brought Rs. 3.10 crore across 4,157 shows, and the India net reached Rs. 336.10 crore. Day 16 rose to Rs 5 crore, lifting the total to Rs. 341.10 crore net and Rs. 408.77 crore gross. The India gross had already crossed Rs. 400 crore on Day 15.‘Drishyam 3 The Conclusion’ overseas collection and worldwide totalOverseas, the film made Rs. 89 crore in week 1, led by Rs. 18.50 crore on Day 1, Rs. 23 crore on Day 2 and Rs. 21 crore on Day 3. Week 2 added Rs. 27 crore, taking the overseas gross to Rs. 116 crore. Day 15 brought Rs. 1.50 crore and Day 16 added Rs. 2.50 crore, so the overseas gross is now Rs. 120 crore. Together with the India gross, the worldwide total stands at Rs. 528.77 crore.'Drishyam 3 The Conclusion' Day 17 collection live trackingAccording to Sacnilk, the film is running across 2,557 shows on Day 17 and has earned Rs 2.90 crore net so far.This takes the India net to Rs 344.00 crore and the India gross to Rs 412.19 crore. The final Day 17 number and the overseas figures are yet to be tallied and will be reported at the end of the day.Day wise collections for 'Drishyam 3 The Conclusion'Week 1: Rs. 245.50 croreWeek 2: Rs. 87.50 croreDay 15: Rs. 3.10 croreDay 16: Rs. 5.00 croreDay 17: Rs. 2.90 croreTOTAL: Rs. 344.00 croreMore about 'Drishyam 3 The Conclusion'Certified UA by the CBFC, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' delivers a grand climax to the long-standing legal and emotional war between the Salgaonkar family and the police force. Director Abhishek Pathak weaves a fresh narrative where Vijay Salgaonkar (Ajay Devgn) once again uses his unmatched wit and movie-inspired logic to shield his loved ones from an escalating police investigation.The film features Ajay Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar, with Tabu returning as Meera Deshmukh. Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta and Mrunal Jadhav play members of Vijay’s family, while Rajat Kapoor returns as Mahesh Deshmukh. The cast also includes Jaideep Ahlawat and Prakash Raj in key roles.Director Abhishek Pathak has said that the film is intended to conclude the Hindi franchise, describing its ending as a fitting closure. In a recent report, he ruled out plans for a fourth instalment for now, despite the film’s strong box-office performance.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources.
